description: Retrieval guard questions over tests/fixtures/sample_repo. Gold files were read off the fixture source by hand, never from tool output. The fixture repeats one calculator in twelve languages, so most questions only resolve if the language or a distinctive identifier is weighed, which is what makes a 42-file repo discriminating.

questions.query: Divide in the Go service returns an error when the divisor is zero, where is that check?
Add returns the wrong sum when main calls the Go calculator
questions.basis: main() calls calc.Add; Calculator.Add is defined in calculator.go

questions.query: History returns a copy of the records but ClearHistory reuses the slice in the Go calculator
questions.basis: History and ClearHistory methods on the Go Calculator

questions.query: New returns a Calculator with an empty history in the Go package
RunOperation reports unknown operation for a valid operation name
questions.basis: RunOperation switch with the unknown operation default

questions.query: Summary on a Go CalculationRecord is formatted with two decimals when the calculator records an operation
questions.basis: record() builds Summary with Sprintf; CalculationRecord is declared in types.go

questions.query: Clear does not reset the history of the Python Calculator
Last returns None when the Python calculation history is empty
questions.basis: CalculationHistory.last returns None on empty entries

questions.query: Calculate rejects a divide request with y equal to zero before sending it
questions.basis: ApiClient.calculate calls validateRequest, which rejects divide by zero
